description: Decode EVM calldata, return data, revert data or event logs against an ABI — Decodes hex calldata (selector plus arguments), function return data, revert data or an event log against a caller-supplied ABI using ethers, for agents inspecting a transaction before signing or after it fails. Handles tuples, nested and dynamic arrays, bytes and strings, and the built-in Error(string) and Panic(uint256) reverts; a strict re-encode check flags trailing bytes, dirty padding and no

abi.description: Fragments of the contract ABI (JSON objects or human-readable strings).

items.description: JSON ABI fragment object or human-readable signature string.

data.description: 0x-prefixed hex, whole bytes; up to 20000 bytes.

function.description: mode return: function name or signature.

mode.description: Default call: data is selector plus arguments.

name: calldata-decode
